additional_named_participant_not_a_count.note: PIB's own sentence groups this with the 'eleven countries' but it is a trade chamber, not a state Government of India recognizes as a country. Kept as a separate, clearly-labeled entry rather than folded into the country count.

company_level_exhibitors.coverage_note: Company-level foreign flagging was only possible for the subset of exhibitors whose names in the official PDF carry an explicit ' - <Country>' suffix. This pattern is used exclusively in the Hall 1 Ground Floor section (the International Pavilion). No other hall/section in the 503-row document uses this convention, and no separate structured 'foreign exhibitors' table exists in the PDF -- company-level foreign identification elsewhere in the fair is not possible from this source.
